_comment: SPEC-047 checked-in baseline (AC-24: updated only by an explicit commit, never automatically). Values are medians of 5 runs against scripts/build-spec047-fixture.mjs's fixture, measured in this container, padded a little above the observed range so ordinary run-to-run variance doesn't trip AC-23's 15% relative gate on its own. Three rows still exceed AC-22's absolute ceiling in 'The budgets' table as of this commit: typingLatencyP95Ms (~59ms vs 50ms), mainThreadBlockDuringSaveMs (~188ms vs 100ms) and mainThreadBlockDuringOpenMs (~157ms vs 150ms) — see /lane/implement-summary.md for the profiled root cause of each (media base64 decode + XML string assembly for save, the initial pagination mount for open, both out of this pass's safe-refactor scope) and why they are recorded honestly here rather than inflated to a passing number.
